entities.name: Jean de Murat de Cros
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean de Murat du Cros was a French cardinal of the Catholic Church. He became the Bishop of Limoges (1347–1371). He was a leader in what became the Great Schism within Western Christianity.
